m: Curry sauce: soften the diced onion and carrot in a little oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Stir in half the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock powder dissolved in ¾ cup hot water per serve. Simmer 15 minutes, add the honey and soy, then blitz smooth.
Cook the rice. Slaw: shred the cabbage thin and toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch of salt and sugar.
Flatten the thighs a little. Dust in the remaining flour, dip in beaten egg, press into the panko.
Shallow-fry in 1cm of oil, 4 minutes a side, until deep golden and cooked through. Drain and rest 2 minutes, then slice.
Plate the rice, chicken and slaw, and pour the curry sauce alongside.
l: Keep the sauce separate and reheat the chicken in the oven or air fryer so it stays crunchy.
g: GF flour in the sauce (make a small separate pot) and for crumbing, with GF crumbs. Tamari instead of soy. Fry the GF chicken first in fresh oil.
